overview.description: The Northern Trust ESG & Climate US Large Cap Core ETF (FEUS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund tracks a principles-based index of US-listed large-cap companies that exhibit environmental, social, and corporate governance (ESG) characteristics. FEUS was launched on Sep 20, 2021 and is issued by Northern Trust.
